purpose: Turn the thirteen registered gravity/light ontology nodes into distinct, falsifiable theory cards with explicit state spaces, operators, limits, observables, synthetic probes, and stop conditions. These are not radial-formula variants and carry no observational authority.

cards.name: classical_spacetime_geometry
cards.lay_seed: Gravity is curved spacetime; matter and light follow the geometry rather than receiving an ordinary force.
cards.state_space: A Lorentzian metric modulo diffeomorphisms with constrained initial data.
cards.operator_seed: G_mn + Lambda g_mn = 8 pi G T_mn / c^4
cards.dimensions: g dimensionless in coordinate convention; curvature L^-2; T energy L^-3.
cards.source_coupling: Universal stress-energy coupling through one metric.
cards.classical_limit: Newtonian Poisson gravity in weak, slow, static fields.
cards.matter_observable: timelike geodesics and self-gravitating fluid motion
cards.photon_lensing_observable: null geodesics, convergence, shear, and time delay
cards.clock_redshift_observable: proper time and gravitational redshift from the same metric
cards.radiation_observable: tensor metric radiation in dynamical solutions
cards.synthetic_probe: weak-field lapse recovers Newtonian acceleration and universal clock/photon coupling
falsifiers: different unmotivated matter and photon metrics
cards.claim_boundary: Control only; this package does not rederive or observationally revalidate general relativity.

cards.name: classical_tensor_gravitational_waves
cards.lay_seed: Gravity can propagate as two transverse tensor-wave polarizations at light speed in general relativity.
cards.state_space: Gauge-reduced transverse-traceless perturbations on a declared background.
cards.operator_seed: box h_TT_ij = 16 pi G T_TT_ij / c^4
cards.dimensions: h_TT dimensionless; omega and c|k| both T^-1.
cards.classical_limit: Static sector does not create a propagating wave; radiation vanishes with time variation.
cards.matter_observable: tidal strain on separated test masses
cards.radiation_observable: two tensor polarizations with omega^2=c^2 k^2 in vacuum
cards.synthetic_probe: plane transverse-traceless wave has zero trace, zero longitudinal divergence, and omega=c|k|
falsifiers: wrong vacuum dispersion in the GR limit
energy loss inconsistent with the source solution
cards.claim_boundary: Control only; no new wave observation is performed.

cards.name: massless_spin2_quantum_field_graviton
cards.lay_seed: If weak gravitational waves are quantized like light, their smallest excitations are massless spin-2 gravitons.
cards.state_space: Gauge-reduced spin-2 Fock space or low-energy gravitational EFT Hilbert space.
cards.operator_seed: H = sum_k,lambda hbar omega_k (a_dagger a + 1/2), omega=c|k|
cards.dimensions: hbar omega is energy; occupation is dimensionless.
cards.source_coupling: Stress-energy couples to the spin-2 field with Planck-suppressed strength.
cards.classical_limit: Large coherent occupation reproduces a classical weak gravitational wave.
cards.matter_observable: quantized tidal exchange in a fully specified detector
cards.photon_lensing_observable: classical mean metric plus quantum fluctuations
cards.synthetic_probe: number states have nonnegative hbar omega energy and coherent-state relative fluctuations fall as occupation^-1/2
falsifiers: failure of the classical coherent-state limit
cards.claim_boundary: A low-energy theory card, not a graviton detection or a UV-complete quantum gravity theory.

cards.name: quantum_states_of_gravity
cards.lay_seed: The gravitational field may occupy superpositions, become entangled, and decohere rather than always having one classical value.
cards.state_space: Positive trace-one density operators on a declared gravitational Hilbert space.
cards.operator_seed: rho_dot = -i[H,rho]/hbar plus only explicitly declared completely-positive decoherence terms
cards.dimensions: rho and probabilities dimensionless; H energy.
cards.source_coupling: Quantum matter and gravitational degrees couple through a specified joint Hamiltonian.
cards.classical_limit: Decohered narrow states yield an effective classical geometry only when demonstrated.
cards.radiation_observable: quantum state of radiative gravity modes
cards.synthetic_probe: two-level unitary evolution preserves Hermiticity, positivity, trace, and purity
falsifiers: trace loss without an exchange channel
cards.claim_boundary: Formal state grammar only; it does not establish that the observed gravitational field is quantum.

cards.name: massive_or_finite_range_carrier
cards.lay_seed: Gravity may include a carrier with mass, so its static influence fades exponentially and its waves disperse.
cards.state_space: A constrained massive field with a declared spin representation and healthy physical modes.
cards.operator_seed: (box - m_g^2 c^2/hbar^2) psi = source; omega^2=c^2 k^2+m_g^2 c^4/hbar^2
cards.source_coupling: Universal or composition-dependent source coupling must be explicit.
cards.classical_limit: m_g to zero must recover the intended massless theory without a discontinuity or must state its screening mechanism.
cards.matter_observable: Yukawa acceleration and possible fifth-force signature
cards.photon_lensing_observable: metric-slip-dependent lensing, never inferred from matter force alone
cards.clock_redshift_observable: potential-dependent proper-time shift in a completed metric
cards.radiation_observable: frequency-dependent group velocity and extra polarizations if present
cards.synthetic_probe: massive dispersion has subluminal group speed and Yukawa kernel tends to inverse radius as mass tends to zero
falsifiers: wrong wave arrival or Solar limit
cards.claim_boundary: Generic carrier seed only; no claim that a particular massive-gravity theory is healthy.

cards.name: extra_scalar_vector_or_tensor_modes
cards.lay_seed: Gravity may contain additional scalar, vector, or tensor channels beyond the two tensor waves of general relativity.
cards.state_space: Direct sum of explicitly constrained spin sectors on a common background.
cards.operator_seed: K_ab box q_b + M_ab q_b = J_a with constraints and kinetic signature derived from one action
cards.dimensions: field normalization and every kinetic/mass entry must be declared per model.
cards.source_coupling: Trace, current, or anisotropic stress couplings must be action-derived.
cards.classical_limit: Extra modes decouple or screen in the declared GR limit.
cards.matter_observable: fifth force, preferred-frame effect, or modified growth
cards.photon_lensing_observable: metric slip and polarization-dependent propagation if derived
cards.clock_redshift_observable: extra scalar/vector contribution to proper time
cards.radiation_observable: breathing, longitudinal, vector, or extra tensor polarizations
cards.synthetic_probe: toy diagonal kinetic matrix counts modes and rejects a negative kinetic eigenvalue
cards.claim_boundary: Mode inventory only; different scalar/vector/tensor theories are not treated as equivalent.

cards.name: gravitational_superposition_and_mediated_entanglement
cards.lay_seed: If gravity can place two test masses into entanglement while remaining the only mediator, the mediator must possess nonclassical degrees of freedom under the proposal assumptions.
cards.state_space: Tensor-product probe Hilbert spaces plus a mediator with two noncommuting observables.
cards.operator_seed: branch phases phi_ij = -G m1 m2 t/(hbar r_ij), followed by a preregistered entanglement witness
cards.source_coupling: Branch-dependent gravitational interaction Hamiltonian with all direct electromagnetic/Casimir channels bounded.
cards.classical_limit: Incoherent branch mixtures must not generate the same certified witness under the declared assumptions.
cards.clock_redshift_observable: branch-dependent proper-time phase only in a completed model
cards.radiation_observable: not required for the tabletop witness
cards.synthetic_probe: a nonseparable four-branch phase matrix produces nonzero concurrence while additive local phases produce zero
falsifiers: classical side channel can reproduce witness
cards.claim_boundary: Proposal-level discriminator; no experiment is performed and no quantum-gravity conclusion is claimed.

cards.name: semiclassical_and_stochastic_gravity
cards.lay_seed: The average quantum stress may curve a classical metric while stress fluctuations add correlated gravitational noise.
cards.state_space: Classical metric histories driven by expectation values and a positive-semidefinite stochastic source covariance.
cards.operator_seed: G_mn[g+h] = 8 pi G (<T_mn> + xi_mn)/c^4 with <xi xi>=noise_kernel
cards.dimensions: xi has stress-energy dimensions; covariance has stress-energy squared.
cards.source_coupling: Mean and symmetrized stress fluctuations of a declared quantum matter state.
cards.classical_limit: Noise kernel to zero recovers the semiclassical mean equation; hbar-sensitive terms to zero recover classical sourcing.
cards.photon_lensing_observable: lensing covariance and scintillation-like metric noise
cards.synthetic_probe: a symmetric positive-semidefinite covariance generates reproducible zero-mean samples and its zero-noise limit is deterministic
cards.claim_boundary: Formal stochastic route only; no astrophysical noise has been detected here.

cards.name: emergent_thermodynamic_entropic_information_gravity
cards.lay_seed: Gravity may be a collective thermodynamic or information response rather than a fundamental microscopic force.
cards.state_space: A declared microscopic or coarse-grained ensemble with entropy and state-counting rules.
cards.operator_seed: F Delta x = T Delta S plus a microscopic closure that derives, rather than assumes, the spacetime equations
cards.dimensions: T Delta S is energy; entropy and information conventions explicit.
cards.source_coupling: Matter changes the ensemble or boundary information according to a specified map.
cards.classical_limit: Newton/Einstein behavior must emerge with the correct equivalence and conservation laws.
cards.photon_lensing_observable: emergent null geometry, not a matter-force copy
cards.clock_redshift_observable: emergent proper time from the same state
cards.radiation_observable: collective tensor or other modes derived from microscopic dynamics
cards.synthetic_probe: the declared Unruh-temperature and entropy-displacement relations algebraically recover F=ma while exposing which relations were assumptions
falsifiers: failure to derive light/clock sectors or conservation
cards.claim_boundary: Neighbor map and algebraic probe only; the heuristic input relations are not counted as a microscopic derivation.

cards.name: discrete_or_causal_quantum_geometry
cards.lay_seed: Spacetime may be built from discrete causal events rather than a continuous background.
cards.state_space: Locally finite causal partial orders or another exact discrete geometry with amplitudes or probabilities.
cards.operator_seed: sum or path integral over admissible causal histories with a specified discrete action and continuum limit
cards.dimensions: event number dimensionless; discreteness scale is a length or four-volume scale.
cards.source_coupling: Matter labels or fields on the discrete structure with a local conservation rule.
cards.classical_limit: Coarse graining must recover Lorentzian geometry and local field propagation.
cards.photon_lensing_observable: emergent null propagation and possible stochastic broadening
cards.radiation_observable: collective radiative modes in the continuum regime
cards.synthetic_probe: finite causal diamond is irreflexive, acyclic, transitive, and relabeling invariant
cards.claim_boundary: Combinatorial gate only; a toy causal set is not a quantum spacetime solution.

cards.name: medium_condensate_and_quasiparticle_gravity
cards.lay_seed: Gravity or spacetime may behave like a collective mode of an underlying medium, with waves analogous to quasiparticles.
cards.state_space: Microscopic or hydrodynamic medium variables plus controlled excitations.
cards.operator_seed: linearized perturbations obey an effective metric wave equation derived from medium conservation and constitutive laws
cards.dimensions: density, sound speed, healing/correlation length, and cutoff explicit.
cards.source_coupling: Matter-medium coupling and backreaction must be specified rather than inferred from a wave analogy.
cards.classical_limit: Long-wavelength excitations mimic selected kinematics; reproducing Einstein dynamics is a separate requirement.
cards.matter_observable: drag, dispersion, defects, or collective force
cards.photon_lensing_observable: only if photons couple to the same effective geometry
cards.clock_redshift_observable: only if physical clocks share the emergent metric
cards.synthetic_probe: positive medium density and sound speed produce a hyperbolic acoustic metric, while a negative kinetic coefficient is rejected
falsifiers: kinematic analogy presented as gravitational dynamics
cards.claim_boundary: Analogue and architecture seed only; analogue kinematics do not establish real gravitational dynamics.

cards.name: nonlocal_memory_persistence_and_corpuscular_gravity
cards.lay_seed: Gravity may depend on past or distant source states, or be a collective state of many soft carriers, instead of responding only point by point.
cards.state_space: History-dependent fields or collective occupation states with an explicit causal domain.
cards.operator_seed: G(x)=G_local(x)+integral_{J-(x)} K(x,x') S(x') dV' with normalized causal K; corpuscular variants require a many-body Hamiltonian
cards.dimensions: kernel times source-volume has the field dimension; memory time and length explicit.
cards.source_coupling: Retarded stress/source history through a covariant kernel or a declared constituent coupling.
cards.classical_limit: Delta-like kernel or short-memory limit recovers the local theory; large occupation must recover a classical field where claimed.
cards.photon_lensing_observable: retarded/path-dependent lensing from the same completion
cards.clock_redshift_observable: local proper time separated from accumulated history effects
cards.radiation_observable: dispersive or damped propagation constrained by a causal spectral response
cards.synthetic_probe: normalized retarded exponential kernel is causal, preserves a constant input, and tends to the local response as memory time shrinks
falsifiers: negative spectral weight where positivity is required
history law collapses to a local rewrite
cards.claim_boundary: Several non-equivalent architectures share this registry node; no equivalence or corpuscular validation is claimed.

cards.name: wildcard_ontology
cards.lay_seed: Reserve room for a genuinely different ontology without letting an undefined idea enter scoring.
cards.synthetic_probe: schema quarantine refuses execution until every required field is replaced by a dimensionally closed definition
falsifiers: silent equivalence to an existing card

status_policy.primary_source_binding: A cited published neighbor is not an independent derivation or validation.
status_policy.target_free_probe: A toy algebraic or numerical invariant can pass while the full theory remains incomplete.
status_policy.quantum_language: Quantum, graviton, state, entanglement, condensate, and corpuscular labels require TG17 before promotion.
status_policy.same_completion: Matter, photon, clock, and radiation observables must ultimately come from one declared completion, not four fitted formulas.
status_policy.counterexamples: Failures stay attached to the exact card and gate; they do not eliminate unrelated ontology families.
